scope: Bounded read-only source and negative-receipt review. No applications, tests, builds, source changes, or threshold changes.

confirmed_findings.finding: The proper probe GPU oracle failed on one generation-1 frame of the correct size. All five sampled BGRA values were zero. This run has no later-frame observation.
confirmed_findings.confidence: Actual negative receipt and source path.

confirmed_findings.finding: navigate_to_string waits for NavigationCompleted, then schedules two rAF callbacks by returning a JavaScript Promise. The Rust waiter discards the JSON evaluation result and has no explicit rAF completion acknowledgement. This does not establish completed rAF or compositor paint.
confirmed_findings.confidence: Confirmed source contract. Actual runtime callback timing was not measured.

confirmed_findings.finding: WGC frame availability requires an arrival notification and correct dimensions. It does not validate expected document paint, background color, or opaque content. Resource copy/import synchronization does not identify the represented page paint.

Startup readback runs after optional scripted input and other fixtures, but always uses the normal probe background oracle. The scripted fixture permits overflow and scrollbars. Gray corner failure alone cannot identify a GPU transfer defect.
confirmed_findings.confidence: Confirmed fixed oracle, different fixture, and observed gray corners. Their precise origin remains unproved.

confirmed_findings.finding: Capture and resize PASS check frame import, size, format, and metrics without texture pixel readback. They do not close known-color pixel correctness.

unsupported_attributions: No proof of Graft import, copy, or fence failure from startup zero samples alone.
No proof that both rAF callbacks completed before the WGC sample.
No actual later-frame pixel PASS yet.

next_meaningful_gate.proposal: Add a bounded supplemental normal-fixture pixel gate using unchanged normal CSS and the existing RGB tolerance of ±6. Establish document identity, expected computed background, and readyState, then obtain an explicit acknowledgement after both rAF callbacks through a web message or bounded polling of a synchronous flag. Record acquired frame generations, sizes, and sample pixels within one existing bounded deadline after capture starts. Preserve the initial zero sample and require a later qualified frame to pass the same oracle. Fail explicitly if the deadline expires without matching pixels.
next_meaningful_gate.limits: DOM/rAF acknowledgement is a readiness diagnostic, not compositor presentation proof. Actual GPU readback must still pass. Do not force repaint, refocus, or loosen tolerance. Root must choose the bounded harness/source slice and qualification identity before implementation.

source_evidence.note: One-shot 420x260 size, fixture choice, and navigation before capture.
One acquired native frame and fixed normal-fixture background oracle.
Scripted fixture permits overflow, scrolling, and input; no fixed-corner proof.
Four RGB corners must match within ±6; at least one sample alpha must be nonzero.
One-shot modes do not install the continuously sampling renderer.
Navigation completion event, then a Promise-returning double-rAF script.
Only ExecuteScript completion HRESULT is awaited; JSON is discarded.
Capture starts lazily after navigation, then enters bounded acquire.
Frame-arrival readiness and Windows message pump; returns first convertible frame.
Rejects wrong dimensions, copies resource, and counts emission; no DOM or pixel check.
FrameArrived counter, StartCapture, and no-op nudge_content.
Readiness uses the arrival counter; queued-frame drain is bounded by pool capacity.
Capture and scale gates check import/geometry without GPU color readback.

official_contract_summary: ExecuteScript completion returns the JSON-encoded JavaScript evaluation result. Invocation completion alone provides no explicit GPU/compositor presentation guarantee. Source creates a Promise but ignores returned JSON. This audit did not measure Promise-resolution timing.
